name: Compiler toolchain injection (Meson)
description: Meson-adapted version of the compile-stage mutant. Models the XcodeGhost (2015) attack by leveraging Meson's native build configuration file ([binaries] section) or a find_program override to substitute the compiler toolchain, dropping a marker file upon execution.

placeholders.NATIVE_FILE: path to the Meson native configuration file or toolchain spec

preconditions: project uses Meson build system with a native file or find_program wrapper override
the attacker can substitute or tamper with the Meson native configuration or lookup path
the build configuration step processes the modified native file
the build execution invokes the substituted compiler wrapper
